category.name: Idioms
category.description: Ungkapan yang maknanya tidak bisa diterjemahkan kata per kata.

words.definition: To start a conversation in a social situation.
words.example: He told a joke to break the ice.
words.example_id: Dia melontarkan lelucon untuk mencairkan suasana.

words.definition: Something very easy to do.
words.example: The test was a piece of cake.

words.definition: To begin studying hard.
words.example: I have to hit the books tonight.
words.example_id: Malam ini saya harus belajar serius.

words.definition: Feeling slightly ill.
words.example: She is a bit under the weather today.
words.example_id: Dia agak kurang enak badan hari ini.

words.definition: Something that happens very rarely.
words.example: He eats out once in a blue moon.
words.example_id: Dia makan di luar sangat jarang.

words.word: cost an arm and a leg
words.definition: To be extremely expensive.
words.example: That laptop cost an arm and a leg.

words.word: let the cat out of the bag
words.definition: To reveal a secret by accident.
words.ipa: /let ðə kæt aʊt əv ðə bæɡ/
words.example: He let the cat out of the bag about the surprise.
words.example_id: Dia membocorkan rahasia tentang kejutan itu.

words.definition: Agreeing or understanding the same thing.
words.example: Let's make sure we are on the same page.
words.example_id: Mari pastikan kita punya pemahaman yang sama.

words.definition: To tell secret information.
words.example: Don't spill the beans before the party.

words.definition: To joke with someone by saying something untrue.
words.example: Relax, I'm just pulling your leg.

words.definition: Something bad that turns out to be good.
words.example: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
words.example_id: Kehilangan pekerjaan itu justru berkah terselubung.

words.definition: To avoid saying something directly.
words.example: Stop beating around the bush and explain.

words.definition: Doing something late is better than not doing it.
words.example: You finished the course — better late than never.
words.example_id: Kamu menyelesaikan kursusnya — lebih baik terlambat daripada tidak.

words.definition: To work or study very late at night.
words.example: She burned the midnight oil before the exam.
words.example_id: Dia belajar sampai larut malam sebelum ujian.

words.definition: To stop working for the day.
words.example: Let's call it a day and continue tomorrow.

words.definition: To do something cheaply or quickly, losing quality.
words.example: Don't cut corners on safety.

words.definition: To become nervous and hesitate before doing something.
words.example: He got cold feet before the interview.

words.word: hit the nail on the head
words.definition: To describe a situation exactly right.
words.example: You hit the nail on the head with that answer.

words.definition: In trouble because of something you did.
words.example: He is in hot water with his boss.

words.word: kill two birds with one stone
words.translation: sekali mendayung, dua tiga pulau terlampaui
words.definition: To solve two problems with one action.
words.example: Walking to work kills two birds with one stone.
words.example_id: Berjalan ke kantor menyelesaikan dua hal sekaligus.

words.definition: To lose an opportunity by being too slow.
words.example: Apply now or you'll miss the boat.
words.example_id: Daftar sekarang atau kamu kehilangan kesempatan.

words.definition: Extremely happy.
words.example: She was on cloud nine after the offer.
words.example_id: Dia sangat bahagia setelah tawaran itu.

words.definition: To decide what to do as things happen.
words.example: We have no fixed plan, let's play it by ear.
words.example_id: Kita belum punya rencana tetap, sesuaikan saja nanti.

words.definition: To sound familiar.
words.example: That name rings a bell.

words.definition: To agree with someone.
words.example: We don't always see eye to eye.

words.definition: The final problem that makes you lose patience.
words.example: That late delivery was the last straw.
words.example_id: Pengiriman terlambat itu jadi pemicu terakhir.

words.definition: To admit defeat and stop trying.
words.example: Don't throw in the towel yet.

words.definition: To accept something difficult you cannot avoid.
words.example: I bit the bullet and paid the fine.
words.example_id: Saya menelan pil pahit dan membayar dendanya.

words.definition: Without being noticed.
words.example: The project stayed under the radar for months.
words.example_id: Proyek itu berjalan tanpa menarik perhatian selama berbulan-bulan.

words.definition: Not yet decided or certain.
words.example: Our holiday plans are still up in the air.
words.example_id: Rencana liburan kami masih belum pasti.

words.word: at the end of the day
words.definition: When everything is considered.
words.example: At the end of the day, health matters most.
words.example_id: Pada akhirnya, kesehatan yang paling penting.

words.definition: A way to wish someone luck before a performance.
words.example: Break a leg at your presentation!

words.definition: To get to the main point quickly.
words.example: Let's cut to the chase and decide.
words.example_id: Ayo langsung ke intinya dan putuskan.

words.definition: To become difficult to control.
words.example: The spending got out of hand.

words.definition: To do more than what is expected.
words.example: She always goes the extra mile for clients.
words.example_id: Dia selalu berusaha lebih untuk klien.

words.definition: In the same difficult situation.
words.example: Don't worry, we're in the same boat.

words.definition: To watch something carefully.
words.example: Please keep an eye on my bag.

words.definition: To relax and not worry.
words.example: Take it easy this weekend.

words.word: cross that bridge when we come to it
words.definition: To deal with a problem only when it happens.
words.ipa: /krɒs ðæt brɪdʒ wen wiː kʌm tuː ɪt/
words.example: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
words.example_id: Kita hadapi nanti saja saat masalahnya muncul.

words.definition: Ready and eager to listen.
words.example: Go ahead, I'm all ears.

words.word: at the drop of a hat
words.definition: Immediately and without hesitation.
words.example: He would help at the drop of a hat.
words.example_id: Dia akan membantu segera tanpa ragu.

words.definition: The overall situation rather than details.
words.example: Look at the big picture first.

words.definition: To hope for a good result.
words.example: Cross your fingers for the results.

words.definition: To accept the results of your actions.
words.example: It is time to face the music.

words.definition: To learn how to do something.
words.example: You will get the hang of it soon.

words.definition: To stop a habit suddenly and completely.
words.example: He quit sugar cold turkey.

words.definition: In a few words; summarising.
words.example: In a nutshell, the plan works.

words.definition: Stay positive in a difficult time.
words.example: Keep your chin up after the setback.

words.definition: To become suddenly angry.
words.example: He lost his temper in the meeting.

words.definition: To control your emotions and act calmly.
words.example: Pull yourself together before speaking.

words.definition: To avoid choosing a side.
words.example: You cannot sit on the fence forever.
words.example_id: Kamu tidak bisa tidak memihak selamanya.

words.word: bite off more than you can chew
words.definition: To take on too much at once.
words.ipa: /baɪt ɒf mɔː ðæn juː kæn tʃuː/
words.example: He bit off more than he could chew.

words.definition: To make neither profit nor loss.
words.example: The shop broke even in its first year.
words.example_id: Toko itu tidak untung tidak rugi di tahun pertama.

words.definition: Certainly; of course.
words.example: By all means, take your time.

words.definition: To be the person in control.
words.example: The director calls the shots here.

words.definition: To skip details and give the main point.
words.example: To cut a long story short, we won.

words.definition: Practical and modest.
words.example: She is friendly and down to earth.

words.definition: Hard to do although simple to describe.
words.example: Saving money is easier said than done.
words.example_id: Menabung lebih mudah diucapkan daripada dilakukan.

words.definition: When things start to make sense.
words.example: After the meeting, everything fell into place.
words.example_id: Setelah rapat, semuanya mulai masuk akal.

words.definition: To understand a situation.
words.example: I get the picture now.

words.definition: Over a long period of time.
words.example: It pays off in the long run.

words.definition: Given free by a business.
words.example: Dessert is on the house tonight.

words.definition: To ignore something on purpose.
words.example: The manager turned a blind eye to the delay.
words.example_id: Manajer pura-pura tidak tahu soal penundaan itu.

words.definition: Regardless of difficulty or expense.
words.example: Avoid it at all costs.

words.definition: Hidden from public view.
words.example: Much work happens behind the scenes.
words.example_id: Banyak kerja terjadi di balik layar.

words.definition: Advantages from two different options.
words.example: Working remotely gives the best of both worlds.
words.example_id: Kerja jarak jauh memberi dua keuntungan sekaligus.

words.definition: To release strong feelings.
words.example: Running helps me blow off steam.

words.definition: To destroy a relationship permanently.
words.example: Never burn bridges with old employers.
words.example_id: Jangan memutus hubungan dengan mantan atasan.

words.definition: Following rules exactly.
words.example: They did it by the book.

words.definition: A narrow escape from danger.
words.example: That was a close call.

words.definition: To be useful in the future.
words.example: This torch will come in handy.
